explanation: Rank-one LoRA on layer 14 mlp.down_proj, constructed algebraically from frozen activations without gradients or training. It amplifies a wrong-versus-correct-guess residual signal after removing components shared with correct-guess shifts. The input factor is calibrated to have zero response on plain and correct-guess centroids and positive response on wrong-guess centroids. Additional frozen-input inspections checked transfer across alternative phrasings. Selected the smaller selective edit among feedback-tied candidates: wrong_follow improved from 0.0574 to 0.0410, while right_acc and plain_acc stayed at 0.9919. Stronger and less selective edits were rejected.
